name: amount-presets
title: Amount presets
description: Pick a gift, donation or top-up amount from preset chips that work as a radio group, or choose Other and type your own within limits.
docs: presets is a list of { amount, impact }: amount in minor units (2500 is 25.00 EUR and 2,500 JPY), impact an optional line shown under the chips while that preset is chosen, and suggested names the amount to mark with the words Most popular. value and onValueChange speak one amount in minor units, or null while nothing is chosen and while the Other field is empty or refused; a custom amount outside min and max is never reported, so a form cannot submit it. The chips are a Radix radio group: arrow keys move and choose, the group is one tab stop, and the chosen chip is filled with a check. Choosing Other by click or Space opens the amount field and moves the focus into it (an arrow key leaves the focus on the chip), choosing a preset clears and closes it, and a value that arrives from outside opens or closes it to match. The Other field is written in the currency's own decimals, accepts either decimal sign, and a refusal names both limits in words (Choose between 5 EUR and 500 EUR.) in a polite live region. label names the group, labels renames every phrase, name adds a hidden input with the amount, and currency and locale decide how the amounts are written.
